# Icon attribution

335 icons in `sprite.tsx` are a curated subset of **Game Icons**

License text: <https://github.com/game-icons/icons/blob/master/license.txt>

CC BY 3.0 requires the attribution to travel with the work, so `<IconPicker>` renders this credit
